CRITICAL DOGFOOD FINDING (cockpit liveness under in-process load — feed back as next work):
1. Cockpit HARD-FREEZES under in-process bro load. With 2 in-process brodex bros pegging daemon at 99% CPU, the cockpit /control/roster/stream SSE repeatedly fails: `error decoding response body` ~every 3 min + seq gaps (lost ~30 deltas, expected=12726 got=12757). UI render loop stalls ("last" column frozen, Down key no-op). Daemon HTTP itself stays fast (/control/roster 3.6ms) — so it's CLIENT-side SSE-decode/reconnect fragility + likely the /control/exec dispatch call blocking the UI thread under load. 3rd+4th cockpit dispatches were DROPPED by the frozen cockpit.
2. Root contributors: (a) SSE stream decode failures + delta loss under load (Slice 1/2 robustness gap — reconnect loses deltas, needs faster/cleaner resync + maybe SSE keepalive); (b) dispatch likely synchronous on UI thread (blocks render when daemon slow); (c) the underlying in-process starvation (campaign note 1) — heavy in-process bros degrade the daemon's smoothness serving the cockpit.
3. Smaller find: managed_worktree surfaces as PARENT dir (.../worktrees/transcript-search) not the per-agent worktree — Slice 2b cwd→worktree mapping resolved one level too shallow; affects proactive-closeout gating accuracy.

NEXT-WORK candidates: cockpit SSE reconnect robustness + non-blocking dispatch (UI thread must never block on /control/exec); revisit in-process starvation; fix Slice-2b managed_worktree depth. LIVENESS ROOT-CAUSE (code-grounded) + FIXES DISPATCHED. Operator's "one core at 99% can't cause hitches on a 14-core box" was right — freeze was NOT capacity:
- A (confirmed): crates/bro-fleet-client/src/fleet.rs:849 DaemonFleetClient.http has .timeout(180s) = TOTAL-request deadline incl streaming body; open_roster_stream (fleet.rs:906) reuses it → reqwest guillotines the infinite SSE at 180s → "error decoding response body" every ~3min UNCONDITIONALLY (load-independent; any cockpit open >3min). Fix: dedicated streaming client, connect_timeout only, NO total timeout, for roster + focused-transcript streams.
- C (confirmed): dispatch()/resume() fleet.rs:915 use block_on_fleet_http on the caller thread → cockpit composer dispatch blocks the render loop up to 180s when daemon slow → hard freeze + dropped #3/#4 dispatches. Fix: fire /control/* off the render thread, reconcile row via roster subscription.
- B (the actual one-core hot path, separate from the freeze): src/orchestration/mod.rs:471 roster_summary_from_task under inner.lock() calls model_from_events(&inner.events):509 find_map — for tasks with no model-bearing event it re-scans the FULL events vec on EVERY emit (per ingested event) → O(N²) single-threaded under lock. Fix: cache model on TaskInner, populate incrementally; bump roster broadcast buffer 128→1024 (state.rs:297).

Daemon fix B → bro_exec brodex fast 4bc4d9f1 (main tree, uncommitted, src/orchestration/mod.rs + src/server/state.rs).
